title: 第十一章 三年之约第十二章 密谋毒计
lines: 第十一章：三年之约
一旁的沈浩看着脸色阴沉，面露杀机，右拳紧握的叶重，心中却是一颤，随即大喝道：“重儿！为了自己，为了你母亲，不要冲动！”。
望着脸庞充斥着暴怒杀机的少年，药曦嫣然眉头轻皱。随即眼角瞟了瞟，那忽然间似乎衰老了许多的沈彤，心头也是略微有些歉然。
药曦轻咬了咬樱唇，沉吟了片刻，淡然深邃的眼眸微微转了转，忽然轻声对叶重道：“今日的事，的确是曦儿莽撞了。今天，我可以暂时收回解除婚约的要求，不过，我需要你答应我一个约定！”。
“什么约定？”，叶重皱眉问道。
“今日的要求，我可以延迟三年。三年之后，你我相约药王谷，落日峰之巅，决战一场。如果我输了，我便当众宣告，将履行婚约；而如果你输了，你就当场解除婚约，你可敢接？我药曦的丈夫必须比我优秀，否则我宁可孤身一人！”，药曦淡淡的道。
“药曦小姐，你又不是不清楚重儿的状况，你让他拿什么和你决战？如此这般侮辱与他，有意思么？”，坐在一旁的沈泰，却是一巴掌拍在桌面之上，怒然而起的大喝道。
药曦却是轻笑道：“呵呵，悔婚这种事，总需要有人去承担责任。若不是为了保全双方的情义，曦儿此刻便会强行解婚，然后公布于众！”。
随即转过头，对着沉默的叶重轻声道：“我对你有信心，你难道对自己都没信心吗？与你对视的时候，我发现你让我心动了。虽然我不相信一见钟情，但我的确是心动了。不过，我还是要证明，你比我优秀，我才会嫁给你！”。
闻言，叶重一愣，随即却是一脸怪笑的轻声道：“这个约定我应下了！不过，如果你没有我想象的优秀，那我却是要退婚，到时你可不要哭鼻子！”。
死死的看了一眼叶重，药曦银铃般的轻笑道：“叶重，我发现我真的喜欢上你了。至少我们的心是一样的！”。
随即只见药曦背后一道火翼展出，直接飞出来了大厅，只传来一道若有若无的话语：“叶重，三年后落日峰之巅见，希望你不要让我失望！”。
看着因为这神转折的情节，满脸吃惊，楞在当场的众人，宗云也是摇了摇头，暗叹道：“现在的小家伙，真是越来越不像话了。不过如果当初我也有这般勇气，至少不会后悔三十余年！”。
随即凌空虚步，对着天空大喊道：“少主，等等老头子我！”。
“三年之后，落日峰之巅见！”，叶重重重的点了点头，然后径直起身，毫不犹豫的对着大厅之外行去。
少年的背影在阳光的照耀下，被拉扯得极长，看上去，孤傲而落寞。
来到堡里后山的庭院，叶重再次心无杂念的握起那把泛着冷光，削铁如泥的精钢重剑，一招一式的舞起剑法来。这是此世叶重所学的唯一一套武技，母亲沈彤亲自传授的四品武技——乾叶剑法。
此剑法旨在以重破巧，由重入轻，化繁为简；有导气炼脉，蕴骨养身之效。虽然在无人时，叶重更习惯练习前世的八卦拳，但在堡内时，为避免不必要的麻烦，叶重却是修习这套乾叶剑法。
就算上世见多识广，通晓百家技艺的叶重，也不得不承认，这是一套非常出色的剑法。这乾叶剑法，放在在上一世，也是各大古武家族门派的不传之密。
在元武大陆，武者之前的修士，并没有特定的修炼功法，修习的都是一套名为“混元一气”的引导术。只有在形成元轮，成为武者后，才会修习特定的功法，一步一步向高阶武者行列前进。
在这片大陆上，武道的修炼，几乎已经在无数代人的努力之下，发展到了巅峰地步，而且由于武道的不断繁衍，最后甚至扩散到了民间之中。这也导致，武道与人类的日常生活，变得息息相关。如此，武道在元武大陆中的重要性，更是变得无可替代。
因为武道的极端繁衍，同时也导致从这条主线中，分化出了无数条武道修炼之法。正所谓手有长短，寸有所短。其中分化出来的武道修炼之法，自然也是有强有弱。
经过归纳统计，元武大陆将武道功法的等级，由高到低分为十品，一品最次，十品最高。
修炼的武道功法等级的高低，也是决定日后成就高低的关键，比如修炼二品功法的人，自然要比修炼一品功法的同等级的武者，要强上几分。

Chapter 11: Three-year Agreement
Shen Hao on the side looked at Ye Zhong, who had a gloomy face, murderous intent on his face, and clenched his right fist, but his heart trembled, and then he shouted: "Zhong'er! For your own sake and your mother's sake, don't be impulsive!".
Looking at the young man whose face was full of furious murderous intent, Yao Xi frowned slightly. Then he glanced out of the corner of his eyes and saw that Shen Tong, who suddenly seemed to have aged a lot, felt a little apologetic.
Yao Xi bit her lips lightly, pondered for a moment, turned her calm and deep eyes slightly, and suddenly said softly to Ye Zhong: "What happened today is indeed that Xi'er was reckless. Today, I can temporarily withdraw my request to terminate the engagement, but I need you to promise me a promise!".
"What agreement?" Ye Zhong asked with a frown.
"I can postpone today's request for three years. Three years later, you and I will meet in Yaowang Valley and have a decisive battle on the top of Sunset Peak. If I lose, I will declare in public that I will fulfill the engagement; and if you lose, you will terminate the engagement on the spot. Do you dare to accept it? My husband, Yao Xi, must be better than me, otherwise I would rather be alone!" Yao Xi said lightly.
"Miss Yao Xi, it's not like you don't know Zhong'er's situation. What do you want him to use to fight you? Is it interesting to insult him like this?" Shen Tai, who was sitting next to him, slapped his hand on the table and shouted angrily.
Yao Xi chuckled and said, "Haha, someone needs to take responsibility for regretting a marriage. If it weren't for the sake of preserving the friendship between the two parties, Xi'er would have forcibly dissolved the marriage at this moment and then announced it to the public!"
Then he turned his head and whispered to the silent Ye Zhong: "I have confidence in you, don't you have confidence in yourself? When I looked at you, I found that you made my heart move. Although I don't believe in love at first sight, I was indeed moved. However, I still have to prove that you are better than me before I will marry you!"
Hearing this, Ye Zhong was stunned, but then he said softly with a strange smile on his face: "I agree to this agreement! However, if you are not as good as I imagined, then I will break off the engagement, so don't cry!"
Glancing at Ye Zhong, Yao Xi chuckled like a silver bell and said, "Ye Zhong, I find that I really like you. At least our hearts are the same!".
Immediately, a fire wing was displayed behind Yao Xi and he flew directly out of the hall. Only a vague word came: "Ye Chong, see you at the top of Sunset Peak in three years. I hope you won't disappoint me!".
Seeing the surprising twist in the plot, Zong Yun shook his head and sighed secretly: "The little guy now is getting more and more ridiculous. But if I had such courage back then, at least I wouldn't regret it for more than thirty years!"
Then he walked in the air and shouted to the sky: "Young Master, wait for me, old man!".
"See you at the top of Sunset Peak in three years!" Ye Zhong nodded heavily, then stood up and walked out of the hall without hesitation.
The young man's back was stretched extremely long under the sunlight, making him look aloof and lonely.
Arriving at the courtyard at the back of the fort, Ye Zhong once again grasped the stainless steel epee, which was glowing with cold light and sharpened like clay, without any distractions, and danced with swordsmanship in every move. This is the only set of martial arts that Ye Zhong has learned in this life, the fourth-level martial arts taught by his mother Shen Tong personally - Ganye Sword Technique.
This sword technique aims to use heavy to break cleverness, from heavy to light, to reduce complexity into simplicity; it has the effect of guiding Qi, refining pulses, and building bones to nourish the body. Although Ye Zhong was more accustomed to practicing Bagua Quan from his previous life when no one was around, but when he was in the castle, in order to avoid unnecessary trouble, Ye Zhong practiced this dry leaf sword technique.
Even Ye Zhong, who was well-informed in his previous life and was familiar with hundreds of arts, had to admit that this was a very outstanding set of swordsmanship. In the previous life, this dry leaf swordsmanship was also an undisclosed secret of all major ancient martial arts families.
In the Yuanwu Continent, the monks before the warriors did not have specific training methods. They all practiced a set of guidance techniques called "Hunyuan Yiqi". Only after forming the Yuan Wheel and becoming a warrior, can one practice specific techniques and advance step by step towards the ranks of high-level warriors.
On this continent, the practice of martial arts has almost reached its peak due to the efforts of countless generations, and due to the continuous proliferation of martial arts, it has even spread to the people. This has also resulted in martial arts becoming closely related to human daily life. In this way, the importance of martial arts in Yuanwu Continent has become irreplaceable.
Because of the extreme proliferation of martial arts, countless martial arts cultivation methods have branched out from this main line. As the saying goes, hands are long and short, and inches are short. The differentiated martial arts training methods are naturally strong and weak.
After comprehensive statistics, Yuanwu Continent divided the levels of martial arts into ten levels from high to low, with the first level being the lowest and the tenth level being the highest.
The level of the martial arts skills practiced is also the key to determining the level of future achievements. For example, a person who practices second-level skills is naturally stronger than a warrior of the same level who practices first-level skills.
